extraFacts.fact: ASTM A269 covers seamless and welded austenitic stainless steel tubing for general service; ASTM A270 covers seamless and welded austenitic and ferritic/austenitic stainless steel sanitary tubing.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A269/A269M and ASTM A270/A270M scope statements (astm.org)

extraFacts.fact: NPT is a tapered pipe thread standardised in ASME B1.20.1; it seals on the thread with sealant (tape or paste).
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1 Pipe Threads, General Purpose (Inch), scope

extraFacts.fact: A concentric reducer keeps both bores on one centreline; an eccentric reducer offsets the smaller bore so one side stays flat, which is why the eccentric type is used on horizontal lines that must drain and on pump suctions.
extraFacts.source: ASME BPE (Bioprocessing Equipment) guidance on drainable hygienic piping; general piping practice

extraFacts.fact: Hygienic clamp ferrules, tank weld ferrules and recessless weld ends are the clamp-joint and weld-end forms used for sanitary tube systems; a sanitary clamp joint is two ferrule faces sealed by one gasket and held by one clamp.
extraFacts.source: ASME BPE (Bioprocessing Equipment) fittings and joint design sections; tri-clamp convention (ISO 2852 clamp couplings)
